item-01.reason: Disabled test isolation lets a locale preference leak from one spec into another.

item-02.reason: The one-time read can occur before the grid renders its headers.

item-03.reason: The export sometimes takes longer than the command timeout.

item-04.reason: The page-wide text locator matches two toast elements and violates strict mode.

item-05.reason: A one-time assertion can catch or miss the brief error-counter flash.

item-06.reason: A shared browser context carries cart state from the first test into the second.

item-07.reason: Visiting the protected page before login produces an unauthorized request.

item-08.reason: The one-time counter read happens before the request completes and the UI updates.

item-09.reason: The expected day changes with the machine's clock and time zone.

item-10.reason: The test always seeks a button that appears only for cancellable orders.

item-11.reason: The saved session cookie has expired and requests redirect to login.

item-12.reason: A click on the server-rendered button is swallowed before hydration attaches its handler.

item-13.reason: The test assumes the feed response has arrived when only the counts response was awaited.

item-14.reason: The helper returns after clicking without waiting for the start operation to finish.

item-15.reason: Additional rendered text makes the page-wide locator resolve to multiple elements.

item-16.reason: The test treats whichever randomized response finishes first as sufficient for a global chip count.

item-17.reason: The mock listing lacks fields required for rendering, while its price assertion also needs updating.

item-18.reason: The session created before the specs expires before the audit log spec runs.

item-19.reason: An older search response can arrive after a newer one and overwrite its results.

item-20.reason: A request from a sibling test reaches the next test's broadly scoped intercept.

item-21.reason: The bare alert-role selector now matches both the inline error and the toast.

item-22.reason: A scroll triggered while the menu opens closes the transient menu before selection.

item-23.reason: The test reloads after clicking Save without waiting for the save request to finish.

item-24.reason: A catch block logs and suppresses the failed avatar assertion.

item-25.reason: The hand-calculated expected total is rounded incorrectly.

item-26.reason: The page object's unscoped sidebar locators no longer identify unique elements after sub-pages added matching links.

item-27.reason: The first click can be swallowed before the server-rendered trigger hydrates.

item-28.reason: The test unconditionally closes a modal that appears only when its seen flag is absent.

item-29.reason: Allowing the failed 404 request without checking its response hides the search URL failure.

item-30.reason: The search behavior violates a valid negative assertion, and assertion mismatch is the closest category for this product behavior bug.

item-31.reason: A new demo adds a second button matching the page-wide locator.

item-32.reason: The form remains in the DOM briefly after the row appears, so the snapshot catches transient content.

item-33.reason: Two waits use the same response pattern and assume a completion order that varies.

item-34.reason: The page and test use different time zones to calculate today's date.

item-35.reason: The test always clicks a banner button that exists only for non-paid accounts.

item-36.reason: The required user exists in an old database but is missing from the current seed.

item-37.reason: The test always clicks a consent button that is absent when consent was already recorded.

item-38.reason: An empty catch suppresses the failed refund response wait.

item-39.reason: Input on the server-rendered fallback is lost when hydration replaces its controls.

item-40.reason: A duplicated context path sends the request to the wrong servlet and yields HTTP 400.

item-41.reason: The substring heading locator matches two headings and triggers strict mode.

item-42.reason: The test begins reconciliation after the start toast without waiting for payment completion.

item-43.reason: Proxying many tile requests makes the preview server occasionally drop a socket under CI load.

item-44.reason: The expected status label was not updated after the product changed it.

item-45.reason: The page object's unscoped list-item locator now also matches the new chat rail.

item-46.reason: The native checkbox changes before hydration, but its client-side change handler does not run.

item-47.reason: Staged subscription rendering replaces a captured card and briefly exposes an empty list.

item-48.reason: Report generation can exceed the fixed three-second wait.

item-49.reason: The closing dialog briefly retains an input that collides with the next view's input.

item-50.reason: A substring heading locator matches both Tasks and All tasks after the list loads.

item-51.reason: The standard-user session lacks the manager role required to render Approve.

item-52.reason: The export sometimes exceeds the assertion's five-second timeout.

item-53.reason: The command converts errors into an ignored false value, hiding the declined payment.

item-54.reason: The hardcoded order ID exists only in old staging data.

item-55.reason: An unmocked cart request returns 401 and causes the app to clear the session.

item-56.reason: Navigating to an external site makes the test depend on that site's availability from CI.

item-57.reason: The Pricing click is swallowed before the server-rendered page attaches its handlers.

item-58.reason: Reusing the page lets dialog state leak from the first test into the second.

item-59.reason: The live third-party forecast request is refused from the CI network.

item-60.reason: Runner-dependent timing makes the simulated flick fall below the speed threshold on slow runs.
